verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents per-integration pages under /integrations/ for AWS (via an AssumeRole role you can delete), GitHub (config, user access and Dependabot monitoring without repo-content access) and Google Workspace (user accounts, Gmail settings). That covers cloud, code hosting and identity with some least-privilege scoping. HR and ticketing integrations are unevidenced, and device management comes from Oneleet's own MDM rather than a connector to a third-party MDM. missing for 10: HR and ticketing integrations, connectors to third-party MDMs, explicit read-only scope statements for each integration, a full catalog listing, independent corroboration.
